question: Should this Gateway public-network hardening bundle be accepted as default-on core behavior, narrowed behind opt-in configuration, or split into smaller reviewed PRs?
rationale: The PR changes public security boundaries, default Gateway availability behavior, and sensitive audit logging policy, which require maintainer intent rather than an automated repair choice.

options.title: Require opt-in/split hardening first
options.body: Refresh the branch, split or gate the risky defaults, complete schema/help/docs/tests, and require real Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Accept default-on hardening intentionally
options.body: Maintainers may choose the stricter defaults, but should document upgrade impact, privacy posture, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof first.

options.title: Close and request narrower proposals
options.body: If the bundle is too broad to review safely, preserve the discussion and ask for separate IP ACL, rate-limit, audit-log, HSTS, and bind-fallback PRs.

recommendation.title: Require opt-in/split hardening first
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, split or gate the risky defaults, complete schema/help/docs/tests, and require real Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is around current Gateway HSTS, bind fallback, and docs behavior that this PR changes.
